title: B-roll cutaway (ffmpeg)
what_it_does: Shows clip B over clip A for a chosen window while A's audio keeps playing (or B's, or a mix), then returns to A. Output stays exactly as long as A. Several cutaways per call.
when_to_use: Adding product or screen footage over a talking-head take at known timestamps.
why: Small, well-documented, does what a B-roll cut needs; an alternative to doing the cutaway as HyperFrames layers when no motion is needed.
